#Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for Research Directors (RD)
[italic]Bellow outlines expectations and permissions granted to a RD given the current alert level:[/italic]
[bold][color=green] Code Green [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] The RD is required to keep a written log of all anomalies. If an anomaly poses immediate threat or danger to the crew, it is required to be eliminated.
[bold]2.[/bold] The RD must preform research. If research is not able to be preformed, the Captain will be contacted for assistant on next steps.
[bold]3.[/bold] The RD is not allowed to bring harmful artifacts outside of their department without being in an artifact container.
[bold]4.[/bold] The RD is allowed to change the Station AIs laws given approval from the Captain.
[bold][color=blue] Code Blue [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Green.
[bold][color=RED] Code Red [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Blue.
[bold]2.[/bold] The RD is permitted to have on their person, a single weapon created in the Protolathe, with the express permission from the Head of Security.
